tool.title: Request review on a merge request (GitLab)
tool.description: Ask one or more users to review a merge request. Adds to the reviewers already requested.

inputs.name: number
inputs.description: Absent: the merge request of the current branch.

selection.when: The change proposals live on GitLab — the checkout's remote is a GitLab project.
selection.limits: GitLab only. For a GitHub repository use `github-pr-request-review`.
selection.cost: `glab`, authenticated (`glab auth login` or `GITLAB_TOKEN`), and one API round trip per call.

remedies.none: No declared Tool reaches the GitLab API another way. A self-managed GitLab answers on its own host, which this record cannot name; `glab` reaches it once `glab auth login --hostname` has been run for that host.

$comment.comment:
`glab mr update --reviewer NAME` replaces the reviewers; `+NAME` adds one.
A Tool input cannot carry that prefix, so the command is a script key: the
script (in the tools layer) adds it after each name parses as a
GitLabUsername (bean folio-assistant-4dbr, owner 2026-10-24 "Fill both gaps").
